Preferred experience with CPSC & AAMC Benchmarking
Experience developing physician dashboards

This position performs analytic support to aid in the physician recruitment and onboarding efforts in the School of Medicine office of the Vice Dean for Clinical Affairs. The incumbent applies professional concepts to conduct analytical studies or projects of moderate scope and complexity to address a variety of policy, research and procedural issues. Fully analyzes issues and problems, gathers data and information, finds and evaluates alternatives and makes sound recommendations. Responsible for reviewing, researching, analyzing and developing strategies to analyze recruitment data, faculty provider onboarding and retention. In collaboration with the finance team, will use clinical practice and faculty productivity measures to establish forecasting and reporting methods to monitor performance against benchmarks. The incumbent will consult with a variety of campus, Medical Center and School of Medicine departments and other sources on a wide spectrum of analytical needs and challenges to develop innovative recommendations and strategic solutions for the Dean’s office. Work completed by incumbent contributes to major SOM objectives and directly impacts SOM departments and supports clinical recruitment and onboarding goals. Experience in physician recruitment, onboarding, and retention will be key for success in this role. This role will also require innovation and development of tools to help with analyzing and reporting.
Working knowledge of common organization- or research-specific and other computer application programs.
Working knowledge of applicable policy analysis techniques.
Proficient in communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Extensive knowledge in Tableau
Proficient in ability to use discretion and maintain all confidentiality.
Knowledge and understanding of physician productivity and performance metrics
Demonstrates ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Demonstrates ability to analyze, research and synthesize large amounts of data with strong attention to detail.
Proficient in ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
